name: Sort Tasks by Due Date
description: The user reorders the task list by due date, toggling between ascending and descending order. Tasks without a due date always appear at the end of the sorted list.
preconditions: The Task List screen is visible

main_flow.description: Reorders the task list by due date in the selected direction

alternative_flows.name: Toggle direction
alternative_flows.trigger: At step 1, the user clicks the sort control again
steps: System reverses the sort order (ascending ↔ descending)

postconditions: Tasks are displayed in the chosen due-date order, with undated tasks at the end
business_rules: Tasks without a due date always appear after those that have one, regardless of sort direction
Sort is applied to the currently filtered list if a filter is active

bdd_scenarios.scenario: Sort Tasks by Due Date — ascending
bdd_scenarios.given: The user is on the Task List screen with tasks that have due dates
bdd_scenarios.when: The user activates the sort-by-due-date control
bdd_scenarios.then: Tasks are reordered with the earliest due dates first; tasks without a due date appear at the end

bdd_scenarios.scenario: Sort Tasks by Due Date — descending
bdd_scenarios.given: The user has ascending sort active
bdd_scenarios.when: The user clicks the sort control again
bdd_scenarios.then: Tasks are reordered with the latest due dates first; tasks without a due date appear at the end

bdd_scenarios.scenario: Sort Tasks by Due Date — sort applied to filtered list
bdd_scenarios.given: The Task List screen is visible with a filter currently active
bdd_scenarios.when: The user sorts tasks by due date while the filtered view is applied
bdd_scenarios.then: The sort order is applied only to the currently filtered subset of tasks, not the full unfiltered list
